name: Bradanicline
summary: Bradanicline (INN; development code TC-5619) is a drug which was being developed by Targacept that acts as a partial agonist at the α7 subtype of the neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. It showed cognitive enhancing effects in animal studies, and was being developed through a collaboration between Targacept and AstraZeneca as a potential treatment for schizophrenia and attention deficit disorder.

pharmacology.text: Bradanicline (INN; development code TC-5619) is a drug which was being developed by Targacept that acts as a partial agonist at the α7 subtype of the neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

uses.text: Bradanicline (INN; development code TC-5619) is a drug which was being developed by Targacept that acts as a partial agonist at the α7 subtype of the neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. It showed cognitive enhancing effects in animal studies, and was being developed through a collaboration between Targacept and AstraZeneca as a potential treatment for schizophrenia and attention deficit disorder.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects were generally mild and included nausea and headache. It did not meet its goals in later studies and was not marketed, so its long-term effects are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應普遍輕微，包括噁心與頭痛。它在後期研究中未達目標，也未上市，因此長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应普遍轻微，包括恶心与头痛。它在后期研究中未达目标，也未上市，因此长期影响不明。

fact.en: It partly activates the alpha-7 nicotinic receptor, the same kind of receptor nicotine acts on, but a subtype linked to thinking and to calming inflammation rather than to the pleasure of smoking.
fact.zh: 它部分活化 α7 菸鹼受體，這與尼古丁作用的受體種類相同，但這個次型與思考功能及抑制發炎有關，而非與吸菸的愉悅感有關。
fact.zhHans: 它部分活化 α7 烟碱受体，这与尼古丁作用的受体种类相同，但这个次型与思考功能及抑制发炎有关，而非与吸烟的愉悦感有关。
